title: Execution Receipt (v1)
description: Signed execution receipt written after the executed tool result lands (SPEC-037 R-1). Closes one signed execution request with the outcome. The signature is the HMAC-SHA256 hex over the canonical JSON of every other field in the envelope (sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace), keyed by the same platform execution-signing key that signed the request.

execution_id.description: The execution request this receipt closes (execution-request.schema.json).

status.description: Execution outcome mapped from the tool result.

outcome_digest.description: SHA-256 hex of the canonical JSON of the tool result the receipt was built from.

request_id.description: The correlating x-request-id of the resumed stream that executed the call; joins the receipt to the audit trail without a new audit dimension.

completed_at.description: UTC timestamp (RFC 3339) of receipt construction after the tool result landed.

signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 hex over the canonical JSON of the envelope excluding this field.
